descriptionChirho: Proper name with dual reference: (1) The personal name of Esau, Jacob's twin brother, given the byname 'Edom' (meaning 'red') after selling his birthright for red stew (Gen 25:30; 36:1, 8). (2) The nation and territory descended from Esau, located south of the Dead Sea in the mountainous region of Seir (Gen 36:9; Num 20:14-21). Edom features prominently in prophetic oracles of judgment (Isa 34:5-6; Jer 49:7-22; Ezek 25:12-14; Obad 1:1; Amos 1:11) and in historical narratives of conflict with Israel (1 Sam 14:47; 2 Sam 8:14; 1 Kgs 11:14-16). Multilingual glosses consistently render as Edom/Edom (arb: أَدُومَ, fra: Edom, hin: एदोम). All auto-clusters represent the same proper noun in different prepositional and conjunctive contexts.
